test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Sparse
solution:
The correct answer is "**Dense**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A word that has the ***opposite meaning*** from another word is called an antonym.
 
• An example of an antonym is **hot and cold**
